facts.fact: The government portal reports that President Sassou N'Guesso commissioned ARPCE's Tier 3+ data centre at Pointe-Noire on 28 February 2024, which will host data of the public administration, the private sector and foreign firms.

COG.note: The data centre is called a tool of digital sovereignty and will be able to host administration data, but no rule or hosting in service is stated.
The document names no online government service.

facts.fact: The government portal says Congo's connection to Meta's 2Africa cable was activated on 28 February 2024 at Pointe-Noire, and that the new data centre is connected to both the WACS and 2Africa submarine cables.
The government portal reports ARPCE's Tier 3+ data centre at Pointe-Noire, built for the State, was commissioned on 28 February 2024.
The data centre was built by the regulator ARPCE on behalf of the State, which the document calls its second after the Brazzaville one built in 2021.
